svg.title: Periodic table outline with every element symbol, groups 1 to 18 across the top and periods 1 to 7 down the side. It is shaded into four blocks. The s-block is groups 1 and 2 plus helium at the top of group 18. The d-block is groups 3 to 12, from period 4 down. The p-block is groups 13 to 18, apart from helium. The f-block is two separate rows printed below the table, cerium to lutetium and thorium to lawrencium.
